title: Herbaflow analysis contract
description: Single upstream source for analysis-domain vocabularies and pipeline-parameter bounds. Read by both stacks. The DB run-status column stays free text (composite 'stage_{N}_{phase}'); only the vocabulary is codified here.

plant_input_mode.description: How the plant/compound side of the run is supplied.

disease_input_mode.description: How the disease side of the run is supplied.

stage_phase.description: Phase suffix in the composite status 'stage_{N}_{phase}'.

stage_source_object.description: A single data source entry: display name + canonical URL (null for pseudo-sources with no public page).

stage_sources.description: Per-stage data-source objects. 'computed' = the sources used in a normal run; 'user_provided' = only the manual-resolution source that runs when an entity stage is supplied by the user. Read by the backend report and the FE StageDataSources. Each entry is {name, url} where url is null for pseudo-sources.

default.name: Set intersection of Stage 3 ∩ Stage 4 (on target_id)

max_mw.description: Molecular weight ceiling (Da). Molecular size: larger molecules permeate membranes more poorly.

max_logp.description: Lipophilicity ceiling (logP, octanol-water partition). Balances solubility against membrane permeation.

max_hbd.description: Hydrogen-bond donor ceiling (Σ N-H, O-H). Each donor adds a desolvation penalty crossing membranes.

max_hba.description: Hydrogen-bond acceptor ceiling (Σ N, O atoms). Adds a desolvation penalty.

max_tpsa.description: Topological polar surface area ceiling (Å²). Polarity: high TPSA lowers absorption (Veber).

max_rotatable_bonds.description: Rotatable-bond ceiling. Molecular flexibility: too flexible lowers oral bioavailability (Veber).

apply_veber.description: Apply Veber's rules (rotatable bonds + TPSA) on top of Lipinski's four.

np_exception_threshold.description: Natural-product-likeness score (Ertl, approx [-5,+5]) at or above which a compound bypasses the rules, protecting genuine plant compounds.

apply_np_exception.description: Allow the natural-product-likeness exception to rescue rule-breaking compounds. Off = strict (no NP rescue).

max_violations.description: Number of the four Lipinski rules a compound may break and still pass (RO5 leniency). Veber is evaluated separately, not in this budget.

skip_adme.description: Bypass ADME screening entirely: every compound passes, flagged not screened.

min_pchembl.description: Minimum pChEMBL (−log10 molar potency) for a measured compound-target edge. 5 ≈ active at ≤10 µM (standard cutoff); 6 = 1 µM; 7 = 100 nM (stricter).

min_assay_confidence.description: Minimum ChEMBL target-confidence score (0-9). 9 = direct single protein; ≥7 high-confidence molecular target; <4 cellular.

min_score.description: Open Targets overall disease-target association score floor.

min_confidence.description: STRING edge-confidence floor (0-1; tiers 0.15/0.4/0.7/0.9). Default 0.4 = medium.

max_proteins.description: Self-imposed STRING ceiling; overlaps above this require allow_top_n_cap.

allow_top_n_cap.description: If the overlap exceeds max_proteins, proceed on the top-N by disease-association score.

network_type.description: STRING network: functional (all association evidence) or physical (binding only).

top_n.description: Number of top-ranked hub genes reported (a descriptive cut, not a significance test).

significance_threshold.description: Corrected-p significance cutoff for enriched terms (applies to whichever correction method is selected).

sources.description: Annotation vocabularies to query. GO branches + KEGG are the default; Reactome (REAC) and WikiPathways (WP) are additionally selectable.

correction.description: Multiple-testing correction: BH-FDR (default), g:SCS (GO-aware), or Bonferroni.

min_term_size.description: Drop terms smaller than this (avoids tiny, unstable annotations).

no_iea.description: Exclude GO terms supported only by electronic (IEA) annotation, keeping curated evidence.

limits.description: App-level input bounds shared by both stacks.

max_plants.description: Maximum plants selectable for one analysis run.

max_compounds.description: Maximum compounds in one analysis run.

max_targets.description: Maximum targets in one analysis run.
